purpose: Minimized handoff for actions that cannot be completed under CCD-011. Placeholder values must be resolved in an approved change record; this packet is not that approval.

external_actions.authority_required: time-bounded read-only staging or production database access approved for deployed-current census
preconditions: bind AUTHORIZED_READ_ONLY_DATABASE_URL without printing it
record deployed revision and database environment
set transaction_read_only on
commands: psql "$AUTHORIZED_READ_ONLY_DATABASE_URL" -X --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --command="BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS transaction_read_only; SELECT count(*) AS registry_total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active) AS registry_active, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_active) AS registry_retired FROM asset_registry; SELECT ar.asset_id, ar.is_active, ods.spec_sha256 FROM asset_registry ar LEFT JOIN asset_output_digest_specs ods ON ods.asset_id = ar.asset_id AND ods.retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY ar.asset_id; ROLLBACK;"
external_actions.success_condition: A reproducible read-only receipt establishes deployed-current asset membership and current reviewed-spec membership without extrapolating from source migrations.
external_actions.rollback: None; read-only transaction ends with ROLLBACK.

external_actions.authority_required: approved staging database migration, Secret Manager, IAM, Cloud Run configuration and signing-key change authority
preconditions: EXT-01 receipt accepted
exact protected source SHA selected
backups and migration change window approved
old and new non-secret KIDs/version IDs recorded

Through a separately approved infrastructure pull request and protected release, configure amjis-web request timeout 360 seconds and amjis-mcp request timeout 360 seconds and instance-based CPU; preserve the existing no-traffic smoke-before-promotion sequence and capture both candidate revision names.
cd platform && DATABASE_URL="$APPROVED_STAGING_DATABASE_URL" npm exec tsx scripts/migrate.ts

psql "$APPROVED_STAGING_DATABASE_URL" -X --set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --command="SELECT filename, applied_at, sha256 FROM _migrations_applied WHERE filename IN ('1033_planner_inquiry_lifecycle.sql','1037_planner_inquiry_action_reservations.sql','1038_planner_managed_prashna_jobs.sql') ORDER BY filename; SELECT c.relname, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relname IN ('planner_inquiry_lifecycles','planner_inquiry_evidence_receipts','planner_inquiry_action_reservations','planner_managed_prashna_jobs') ORDER BY c.relname; SELECT schemaname, tablename, policyname, roles, cmd, qual, with_check FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename IN ('planner_inquiry_lifecycles','planner_inquiry_evidence_receipts','planner_inquiry_action_reservations','planner_managed_prashna_jobs') ORDER BY tablename, policyname; SELECT p.proname, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner, p.prosecdef, p.proconfig FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.proname IN ('create_planner_inquiry_lifecycle','purge_expired_planner_inquiries_global','create_planner_managed_prashna_job','get_planner_managed_prashna_job','claim_planner_managed_prashna_job','update_planner_managed_prashna_job_progress','complete_planner_managed_prashna_job','fail_planner_managed_prashna_job') ORDER BY p.proname; SELECT table_name, grantee, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_name IN ('planner_inquiry_lifecycles','planner_inquiry_evidence_receipts','planner_inquiry_action_reservations','planner_managed_prashna_jobs') ORDER BY table_name, grantee, privilege_type; SELECT routine_name, grantee, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_routine_grants WHERE routine_name IN ('create_planner_inquiry_lifecycle','purge_expired_planner_inquiries_global','create_planner_managed_prashna_job','get_planner_managed_prashna_job','claim_planner_managed_prashna_job','update_planner_managed_prashna_job_progress','complete_planner_managed_prashna_job','fail_planner_managed_prashna_job') ORDER BY routine_name, grantee, privilege_type;"
required_receipts: new and previous public KIDs and secret version numbers without key material
web and MCP candidate Cloud Run revisions with timeout/CPU configuration
rotation overlap and old-KID drain evidence

global_stop_conditions: authority record does not name the exact action, environment and owner
source SHA, protected tip or deployed revision differs from the approved value
a command would print a credential, token, signing key or sensitive chart payload
a required backup, rollback owner or audit sink is unavailable
a local, PR, CI or staging result is being treated as production or empirical acceptance
completion_rule: FULLY_COMPLETE remains prohibited until all applicable external actions have accepted receipts, the protected merged and deployed revision is proven, deployed traces pass, and PA-R08 has an authorized empirical verdict. This source packet itself cannot satisfy those gates.
